column1: This Google Sheet is the control panel for Drishti. Drishti reads the green tabs and writes the grey tabs.
Share this sheet and the Drive folder "Drishti Inbox" with the service account email shown on the Data sources screen (Editor).
Green tabs (you edit): Settings, Products, Channels, Watchlist, Creators, Targets, Calendar, Rules, Users, Mappings.
Grey tabs (Drishti writes; do not edit): Actions, Tests, Source status, Sync log.
Row 1 is the header. Do not rename headers; add columns to the right if you need notes.
Money is in rupees without symbols or commas. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. Percentages are decimals (0.12 = 12%).
All values in this template are fictional (Lumora Skin).
